Current budget: 0.4 + 0.4 + 0.6 + 0.09 = ~1.5 uA, about 2.7 uW. Long-L PMOS mirrors set PSRR and line regulation."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.4e-6, 0.2e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch current (each)
    "ko":     (1.5, 1.0, 2.5),            # output-branch current ratio Io/I
    "vptat":  (0.58, 0.45, 0.70),         # Io*R2 (PTAT term) at 27 C
    "vtgt":   (0.95, 0.93, 0.97),         # Vref target used to set divider R4
    "gmid_p": (13.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_p":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_n": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L_n":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Rsu":    (20e6, 5e6, 50e6),          # start-up sense pull-down
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]; Io = p["ko"] * I
    N = 8
    m1, m2 = 8, 8 * N                     # low current density -> lower Veb -> M2 headroom

    def veb(Ie, m):
        return 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(Ie, 1e-12) / (m * 10e-6))

    # Core PTAT resistor: Veb1 = Veb2 + I*R1
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    veb1 = veb(I, m1)

    # Output branch: Vref = (Veb3 + Io*R2) * R4/(R2+R4)
    R2 = p["vptat"] / Io
    vt = p["vtgt"]
    iq3 = 0.5 * Io
    for _ in range(20):
        veb3 = veb(iq3, 1)
        iq3 = max((vt - veb3) / R2, 0.05 * Io)
    veb3 = veb(iq3, 1)
    R4 = vt * R2 / max(veb3 + p["vptat"] - vt, 1e-3)

    # Devices
    vsb_n = veb1
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I, vds=0.3, vsb=vsb_n)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I, vds=0.7)
    mpo = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Io, vds=VDD - vt)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=m1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=m2)
    n.R("R1", "s2", "e2", R1)
    # NMOS level-shift pair (M1 diode on Q1 side)
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "pg", "ng", "s2", "vss", mn)
    # PMOS mirror (diode on M2 side)
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # Output branch
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mpo)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    # Start-up: sx low when the core is off -> MS1 injects current into ng
    n.dev("MS4", "sx", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RSU", "sx", "vss", p["Rsu"])
    n.M("MS1", "ng", "sx", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    isu = VDD / p["Rsu"]
    power = VDD * (2 * I + Io + isu)
    # Predicted Vref from the Thevenin model
    vref = (veb3 + p["vptat"]) * R4 / (R2 + R4)
    # Line regulation: mirror current sensitivity via PMOS gds
    dI_rel = mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12) * 0.5 + mpo.gds / max(Io, 1e-12) * 0.0 + mp.gds / I * 0.3
    line_reg = min(p["vptat"] * dI_rel * R4 / (R2 + R4) + 0.005, 0.06)
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4))
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": 150.0, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
